note: Hand-judged. Every entry the installed Claude Code lists as write-protected for its own sandbox (extracted by src/qa/claude-code-write-deny-extract.ts, read-only, from the binary's bundled code) has a judgment here; test src/qa/claude-code-write-deny.test.ts fails on a new unjudged entry. ~/.claude.json is protected beyond the extracted list (it holds user MCP server declarations). Nested copies of project entries below a subdirectory are the #449 residual (covered by K's glob Edit denies, not by kernel rules).
